column1: # Per-folder badge for the cmux sidebar: emoji + color, keyed by REPO NAME.
# Painted on SessionStart by cmux-agent-status.sh as a "repo" status pill,
# and applied as the workspace color.
# Format:  <glob matched against the repo name>  <TAB>  <emoji>  <TAB>  <#hex>
# First match wins, so put specific patterns above the catch-all.
# Read on every SessionStart -- no restart needed.
# The name is resolved via `git rev-parse --git-common-dir`, NOT --show-toplevel,
# so a worktree at .worktrees/brobot/fix-thing still badges as "brobot".
